newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Wing Tiek remits $20 mln for Manila firm.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tiek remits $20 mln for Manila firm.

text.p: Malaysia's Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd remitted on Tuesday $20 million and pledged another $20 million to complete its 75 percent buy-in in the Philippines' National Steel Corp (NSC), a government official said.
The payment is part of the $90 million of the $150 million acquisition deal signed by Wing Tiek with state-owned National Development Co (NDC).
NDC assistant general manager Lourdes Rebueno told reporters that the remaining $50 million would be paid by its partner Marubeni Corp of Japan.
Rebueno said Wing Tiek had pledged shares of its subsidiary Ganda Holdings Bhd for the $20 million.
Wing Tiek was given until the end of the month to settle the deal which was won late last year through a public bidding.
Besides the $150 million acquisition cost, Wing Tiek has also agreed to infuse new equity worth 2.3 billion pesos.
NSC accounts for over 40 percent of the local steel output with an annual production capacity of 3.5 million tonnes.
